paragraphs.text: Malcator is a Phyrexian loxodon native to New Phyrexia . As the leader of the executors within the Great Synthesis, Malcator holds the crucial responsibility of deciding which creations are classified as abominations and which meet the ideals set by the Phyrexian hierarchy.

The original Malcator was engineered by Jin-Gitaxias from the first loxodon captured during the Mirran-Phyrexian War. Recognized for his exceptional strength and intelligence, the base creature was nearly perfect, requiring only minimal enhancements. Jin-Gitaxias modified this specimen to serve as the perfect overseer for his most elite research sectives. In this role, Malcator rigorously inspects the outputs of these sectives, ensuring every creation adheres strictly to the Standards of Purity. Any entity failing to meet these exacting requirements is subjected to reinvention—by any necessary method—until it attains the perfection demanded by New Phyrexia's vision.
